name: PSVDAG Label/Caller Encoding with Frequency-Based Compaction
definition: Replaces fixed 32-bit child node pointers with variable-length binary labels/callers to enable pointerless traversal while minimizing memory footprint through level-wise assignment and frequency-based sorting.
summary: PSVDAG replaces fixed 32-bit pointers with variable-length binary labels sorted by frequency, achieving up to 5.33-fold compression while requiring label reconstruction during traversal.
